page.content:
Creation of new oceanic crust at mid-ocean ridges.

How Seafloor spreading connects

  • Location: Mid-Atlantic Ridge — The Mid-Atlantic Ridge is the type locality of slow seafloor spreading.
  • Topic: Oceanography — Seafloor spreading is the plate-tectonic core of modern geological oceanography.
  • Location: Mariana Trench — Trenches consume the crust that ridges create in the spreading cycle.

What is Seafloor spreading?

Seafloor spreading, proven by magnetic stripes and ridge topography, is the plate-tectonic engine that opened the Atlantic and recycles crust into trenches.

Key threads lead to Mid-Atlantic Ridge, Oceanography and Mariana Trench.
